caption:
Stock market news | SEBI KYC reforms December 24 simplify demat account opening

SEBI announced new KYC rules that will be effective from *December 24, 2026*, aiming to make opening demat and mutual fund accounts easier for investors.

The changes reduce documentation, allow portable verified records across intermediaries, and help investors switch brokers without repeated paperwork, encouraging broader market participation.
